visualCharacteristics.purpose: Two-column media/text splits: text beside an image, app mockup, badge or stacked photos, plus text/side-panel and heading/content pairs

contentPattern.structure: one row (or more) with 2 cells: a text cell (heading, paragraphs, lists, CTA links, optional leading icon, optional inline table) and a media cell (one picture, or several stacked pictures), or two text cells. Authored cell order is the visual order. A cell holding only a link to a /fragments/ path is replaced by that fragment, for complex content such as nested tables and FAQ panels

usage: Content and product pages: image/text intros, app promotions, partner badges, side info panels, 'when you make a claim' heading + checklist splits (24 catalogued variants).
reuseGuidance: Use for a 2-column split where one side is media or a side panel. `wide-right`/`wide` give the text column two thirds; `heading-left` gives the second (content) column two thirds; `boxed*` puts text columns in a bordered panel; the `image-*` and `alt` options record source section treatments and only centre the media column structurally. Use cards-feature for 3+ equal cards and columns-links for link lists.
